data.title: 椎名真白 · 毕业展的白色展厅
data.description: 个人画展的白色展厅，她穿着干净的连衣裙站在自己的巨幅画作前，双手背在身后；面对观众依旧是三无表情，但手指在背后悄悄握紧。
data.action: 在巨幅画作前转头，双手藏在背后轻轻握紧。
data.promptProse: Mashiro Shiina stands before her enormous painting at the personal exhibition, both hands held behind her back and fingers quietly tightening despite her impassive face. Her ivory short-sleeved dress and flat shoes keep the silhouette simple. The medium view includes the white gallery wall and visitors facing the work farther behind. Soft gallery light reveals the canvas and clean dress folds, with restrained shadows under the frame and around her clasped hands.
